title: Edge cases
lead: What WH3RE does when it doesn’t know, or when signals contradict each other.

noResults.title: No personal results
noResults.quote: “Nobody in your circle knows this neighborhood well enough yet.”
noResults.text: Widen the criteria · a public discovery · ask the most relevant people

conflicting.title: Conflicting information
conflicting.quote: “Sarah finds this place quiet, but Noam says it gets loud after 10 pm.”
conflicting.text: WH3RE explains the nuance (quiet before 10 pm) instead of picking a side arbitrarily.

closed.title: Closed place
closed.quote: “This place shows up in old recommendations, but now seems to be closed.”
closed.text: Left out of results, kept in your memory with a note.

old.title: Old recommendation
old.quote: “This recommendation is three years old. Want to ask for something more recent?”
old.text: One button drafts the question for the right person.

cancelled.title: Cancelled booking
cancelled.quote: A cancelled booking never counts as a visit.
cancelled.text: Cancellation email detected: the booking is set aside, with no visit signal.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.quote: A Tabit or Wolt order, or any delivery, is not a visit to the restaurant.
delivery.text: Delivery orders are left out of the import.

noImport.title: Without email import
noImport.text: Answers from your friends, post-visit feedback, public data.
